shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/layout.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/ProductGrid.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,280p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- detail ---' && sed -n '1,280p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && printf '%s\\n' '--- skeleton ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- css ---' && sed -n '1,360p' app/globals.css && printf '%s\\n' '--- products ---' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- versions ---\\n' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && node -p \"require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version\" && printf '\\n--- APIs/types ---\\n' && rg -n \"ViewTransition|transitionTypes|viewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react node_modules/next/dist/client node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib node_modules/next/types.d.ts node_modules/react -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import * as React from 'react'; console.log('ViewTransition', typeof React.ViewTransition); console.log('addTransitionType', typeof React.addTransitionType)\" && sed -n '155,195p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- Next config view transition handling ---\\n' && rg -n \"experimental\\.viewTransition|viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,100p'"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- css tail with lines ---\\n' && nl -ba app/globals.css | tail -n 180"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json package-lock.json next-env.d.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- view transitions ---\\n' && nl -ba app/ViewTransitions.tsx && printf '\\n--- detail ---\\n' && nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && printf '\\n--- next env ---\\n' && cat next-env.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/globals.css
@@
   ::view-transition-group(*),
   ::view-transition-old(*),
   ::view-transition-new(*) {
-    animation-duration: 0.001ms "'!important;
-    animation-delay: 0ms !important;
+    animation: none !important;
   }
 }
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    "lib": [
-      "dom",
-      "dom.iterable",
-      "esnext"
-    ],
+    "lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"],
@@
-      "@/*": [
-        "./*"
-      ]
+      "@/*": ["./*"]
     }
   },
-  "include": [
-    "next-env.d.ts",
-    "**/*.ts",
-    "**/*.tsx",
-    ".next/types/**/*.ts",
-    ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"
-  ],
-  "exclude": [
-    "node_modules"
-  ]
+  "include": ["next-env.d.ts", "**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx", ".next/types/**/*.ts"],
+  "exclude": ["node_modules"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git status --short'
